paper.title_en: Joint factorization and resummation of the EEC and thrust in e $^{+}e^{-}$ collisions$^\ast$
paper.abstract_en: We present a joint factorization and resummation study of the energy-energy correlator (EEC) and thrust in $ e^+e^- $ collisions. An analysis of the joint kinematic distribution reveals five relevant regimes that govern how the global event shape constrains local energy correlations. In the collinear limit ($ z \to 0 $), we show that the global thrust boundary strongly constrains the jet substructure, necessitating a sub-jet refactorization. In the back-to-back limit ($ z \to 1 $), the coexistence of $ {\,\mathrm{SCET}}_{{\mathrm{I}}} $ and $ {\mathrm{SCET}}_{{\mathrm{II}}} $ soft scales requires the $ {\mathrm{SCET}}_{+} $ framework. We derive the factorization theorems for all five regimes and calculate the corresponding differential jet functions at one-loop order. By cleanly separating the overlapping soft and collinear modes, our framework provides a systematic factorization description of the EEC under global thrust constraints in the singular limits.
